rationale: The original entry thesis relied on buyer support holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA, which has now failed as price broke below $22.83 and closed at its 1-minute low ($22.78) on increasing volume. With zero favorable excursion in 16 minutes and every recent 1-minute candle making lower highs and lower lows, short-term momentum has broken down. However, the broader trend remains constructive above session VWAP ($22.47) and prior close ($22.67) on 3.23x relative volume, making an outright short flip unfavorable while justifying an immediate exit ahead of the $22.72 stop.
